name: Apex Runner X9
description: Engineered mesh upper with a lightweight foam midsole. Built for high-mileage training with a responsive toe-off and breathable construction that keeps weight low.

name: Court Zero Low
description: Clean-line low-top with a premium suede toe cap and vulcanized rubber cupsole. The kind of sneaker that looks right every day without trying too hard.

name: Peak Summit Boot
description: Full-grain waterproof leather upper with a seam-sealed collar and deep-lug outsole. Ankle support you can feel on switchback terrain. Rated to -10°C.

name: Drift Knit Slip
description: One-piece recycled-knit upper, no laces, flexible EVA sole. It fits like a sock, walks like a sneaker. Best shoe for the days you just need to move.

name: Volt Sprint Elite
description: Carbon-fiber plate embedded in a dual-density foam stack. Made for race day: 8-10mm drop, locked-down lacing system, and a rocker geometry that pushes you forward.

name: Cedar Oxford
description: Hand-burnished calfskin oxford with a genuine Goodyear welt. Built to last, polishable, resoleable. The kind of shoe that gets better with age.

name: Iron Cross Trainer
description: Zero-drop, wide-platform training shoe. Flat and firm for lifting, grippy enough for lateral movement. Minimal stack height so you feel the ground, not just stand on it.

name: Wave Canvas Classic
description: Heavy cotton canvas upper, foxing-tape construction, flat rubber sole. No frills, no foam, no story — just a reliable daily driver that pairs with everything.
